visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-bleed homepage hero carousel with autoplay background video slides and timed progress-bar pagination
notes: Full-bleed autoplay video slides (dark #1d1f22 fallback), uppercase white heading bottom-left, subheading, white pill CTA, timed progress-bar pagination along the bottom. Video/photo background belongs to the block, so the section is not colored.

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide; cell 1 = background media (poster image and/or a link to an .mp4 or Scene7 video), cell 2 = h2 title + subheading paragraph + CTA link
blockContent: 2 slides: "Powering Data" (video, Watch full video button) and "A gateway on the Red Sea" (video, Discover More to portofneom.com); each slide = background video/poster + h2 + subheading + CTA

usage.description: Top-of-page hero with one or more video or image slides that auto-advance.

reuseGuidance: Use for any full-bleed rotating hero. Use hero for a single static slide.
